skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Describe the business environment, organizational structure, and role/function of accounting and analysis in the unit.
Evaluate strengths and weaknesses regarding issues in accounting and analysis activities of the unit.
Demonstrate effective communication skills through written reports and discussions on topics related to accounting and analysis.
Show ability to work independently and collaboratively, professionally adapting to various situations.
Practice self-study, accumulate and reflect on issues in auditing and control activities.
Express and defend personal viewpoints based on objective and scientific approaches.
